We’re excited to serve Bonita Springs, FL as your premier specialty veterinary practice. Fetch is proudly privately owned, treating your pet as a cherished family member and addressing all your concerns and questions. Our board-certified veterinary specialists work in tandem with your regular veterinarian to deliver customized, high-quality care when it’s needed most. If your pet needs advanced medical diagnostics and treatment in a compassionate, state-of-the-art facility, Fetch is just a phone call away.

Our veterinary oncologists are able to diagnose, monitor, and treat various cancers in dogs and cats. If your pet needs help, reach out to Fetch in Bonita Springs, FL for support, guidance, and outstanding treatment.

Radiation Oncology
We utilize state-of-the-art radiation therapy to help our cancer patients live better lives. This treatment is used to eliminate residual cancer cells in the body after surgery has been performed to ensure a better outcome.
Learn More
Electrochemotherapy
Electrochemotherapy
Electrochemotherapy is an innovative treatment option that combines chemotherapy with the power of electrical pulses to target and treat certain types of cancer in pets. This advanced procedure involves injecting a chemotherapy drug directly into the tumor, followed by brief, controlled electrical pulses. The electricity helps the medication reach the cancer cells more effectively, improving its therapeutic effects. Electrochemotherapy offers a promising new approach for treating localized or superficial tumors in pets, providing a more precise, targeted solution with fewer side effects than traditional chemotherapy. It’s an exciting step forward in veterinary oncology and Fetch is proud to be one of the few hospitals able to offer this treatment.
